title: Grateful Dead Live at Hartford Civic Center on 1982-04-17
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.8 MHz) >KORG AudioGate 4 > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/24
source: (FOB) Beyer M160 > Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/TDK MA-C90)

ai_review.summary: A solid audience tape that puts you in the room, featuring strong performances of Shakedown, the Spanish jam and Wharf Rat.
ai_review.review: The listener praises this audience recording for its immersive feel, noting it captures the energy of a "really good show" despite not being a soundboard source. Standout moments include the Shakedown Street groove, an inspired Spanish‑style jam, and a heartfelt Wharf Rat. The overall sound is clear enough to be enjoyable and worth downloading.

ai_rating.rationale: Single detailed 4‑star review highlights strong show performance and acceptable audience recording quality, leading to an overall rating just above four stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience source praised for its immersive ambience; no specific flaws mentioned, though inherently less crisp than a soundboard.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Positive flow with highlighted jams and a solid mix of upbeat and reflective numbers.
